correctness.rationale: The seven-edge acyclic eight-vertex subsets are precisely trees; 4096 equals 4^3*4^3. Each Walsh coefficient is a signed weighted matrix-tree determinant; counting convolution diagonalizes exactly in Boolean characters. Independently enumerated every 16-edge mask with a distinct DSU implementation, performed integer 65536-point Walsh transform, obtained rank 22642, minimum magnitude 32, absolute histogram {0:42894,32:14016,64:896,128:7008,224:32,256:192,288:288,512:144,640:64,4096:2}, verified Parseval and projection inverse transform l1 numerator 2950060. The claimed 192-orbit determinant scheme has exact generation and comparison logic in orbit_check.py; the independent full transform avoids dependence on its certificate. Since convolution kernel l1 mass gives attained l1 and linfinity norm, 2950060/65536=737515/16384 is sharp for this specified spectral projection (no unclaimed universal minimality).
